keywords: Four billfish species in one day. A Watamu boat combination adds swordfish to sailfish, blue marlin, and striped marlin.

title: Flats slam / Alphonse slam
keywords: One Alphonse version pairs a bonefish, giant trevally, and yellowmargin triggerfish, caught by one angler in one day.

title: GT / geet
keywords: Short names for giant trevally.

title: Moustache trigger
keywords: An angler’s name for titan triggerfish.

title: Super slam
keywords: An Alphonse combination of permit, yellowmargin triggerfish, bonefish, and giant trevally, caught by one angler in one day.

title: Ahi
keywords: A local name for yellowfin tuna and bigeye tuna.

title: Aku
keywords: The Hawaiian name for skipjack tuna.

title: Grander
keywords: A marlin that weighs at least 1,000 pounds. Hawaii’s list includes blue and black marlin.

title: Hebi
keywords: The local name for shortbill spearfish.

title: Kahala
keywords: A Hawaiian name for greater amberjack.

title: Ono
keywords: The Hawaiian name for wahoo.

title: Pāpio
keywords: The local name for jacks under 10 pounds; the larger fish are called ulua.

title: Ulua
keywords: The local name for jacks of at least 10 pounds, including giant, bluefin, and black trevally.

title: Donut
keywords: A trip with zero fish caught.

title: Elbow slapper
keywords: A big whiting, imagined with its tail at your elbow when you hold its head.

title: Hoodlum / hoodie
keywords: A large yellowtail kingfish, often over a metre long. The nickname has no fixed cutoff.

title: Jewie
keywords: A common angler’s name for mulloway.

title: Lizard / croc
keywords: A large flathead; croc usually means an especially big one.

title: Metre barra / metrey
keywords: A barramundi at least one metre long; the catch earns a place in a metre barra club.

title: Rat
keywords: A small yellowtail kingfish.

title: Soapie
keywords: A juvenile mulloway.

title: Squire / pinkie
keywords: Names for a small snapper.

title: Kingie
keywords: Short for yellowtail kingfish.

title: Moocher
keywords: A big snapper, especially the trophy fish anglers seek around rocky ground.

title: Pannie / panny
keywords: A pan-sized snapper.

title: Skippie
keywords: Short for skipjack tuna.

title: Stripey
keywords: In this New Zealand usage, a striped marlin.

title: Swordie
keywords: Short for swordfish.

title: Buri
keywords: The adult-size name for Japanese amberjack, around 80 centimetres and up in these examples.

title: Fukko / hane
keywords: A medium Japanese sea bass, roughly 30–60 centimetres: fukko in Kantō, hane in Kansai.

title: Inada / hamachi
keywords: Names for young Japanese amberjack around 40 centimetres: inada in Kantō, hamachi in Kansai.

title: Seigo
keywords: A small Japanese sea bass, roughly 30 centimetres or less in Honda’s Kantō and Kansai examples.

title: Shusseuo
keywords: A fish whose name changes as it grows, such as Japanese amberjack or Japanese sea bass.

title: Suzuki
keywords: The adult-size name for Japanese sea bass, roughly 60 centimetres and up in these examples.

title: Toshinashi
keywords: An angler’s name for a large black sea bream over 50 centimetres.

title: Warasa / mejiro
keywords: Names for larger Japanese amberjack around 60 centimetres: warasa in Kantō, mejiro in Kansai.

title: Haruan
keywords: The Malay name for striped snakehead.

title: Kelah
keywords: A Malaysian name for mahseer.

title: Sebarau
keywords: The local name for hampala barb, also called jungle perch.

title: Toman
keywords: The Malay name for giant snakehead.

title: Billfish fantasy slam
keywords: One angler catches any five eligible billfish species in one calendar day under IGFA rules.

title: Billfish grand slam
keywords: One angler catches any three eligible billfish species in one calendar day under IGFA rules.

title: Billfish royal slam
keywords: One angler catches all nine listed billfish categories over a lifetime under IGFA rules. Any spearfish species fills the spearfish place.

title: Billfish super grand slam
keywords: One angler catches any four eligible billfish species in one calendar day under IGFA rules.

title: Boat slam
keywords: A crew completes a slam with catches from several anglers aboard one boat. IGFA requires one angler for its awards.
